response.sql: WITH per_driver AS (SELECT driverId, SUM(points) AS total_points, AVG(CASE WHEN TRIM(laps) GLOB '[0-9]*' AND TRIM(laps) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*' THEN CAST(laps AS REAL) END) AS average_laps FROM results WHERE grid > 12 GROUP BY driverId) SELECT AVG(total_points) AS average_points_total, AVG(average_laps) AS average_of_average_laps FROM per_driver

assumptions.assumption: “Upwards of 12” means a numerical grid position greater than 12; missing or nonnumeric laps are excluded from lap averages.
